# Telegram API compatibility

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/tl-coverage`. Do not edit by hand: change the code or docs/compat/decisions.yaml and regenerate. -->

Every TL method the server's protocol library knows for Layers 225–232, and what the server does with it.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✅ works | a handler is registered and serves the method |
| 🔵 static | the handler never reads server state: a fixed or empty answer. Right for some methods, a placeholder for others |
| 🟡 partial | the handler answers `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on some paths (options or variants it does not support) |
| 🟠 stub | a handler is registered but always answers `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| ❌ missing | no handler: the client gets `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`-style failure |
| ⚪ not planned | missing or stubbed on purpose, see the note (docs/compat/decisions.yaml) |

**Total: 862 methods** — ✅ works 650 · 🔵 static 32 · 🟡 partial 6 · 🟠 stub 0 · ❌ missing 104 · ⚪ not planned 70 · served 86%
